# Bedrock sound names the game still plays by.
#
# The game names the sounds it plays through sound.Custom by their Java sound event IDs, which the Bedrock
# session maps to Bedrock's sound definitions (server/session/sound_names.go). Each line is a string literal
# of server/{entity,item,block,player,world} that starts with mob., random., bottle., leashknot. or portal.
# and is still a Bedrock name, with the reason it is.
#
# This list is a ratchet, which TestCustomSoundsUseJavaNames in server/world/sound checks: a Bedrock literal
# missing from it fails the test, and so does an entry no file uses any more. Adding an entry needs a
# justification in review.

# Java Edition has no sound for it: its parrots do not imitate happy ghasts.
mob.imitate.happy_ghast

# Level sound event names of sound.NativeEvent, not sound definitions: the game's names for event sounds.
mob.husk.convert_to_zombie
mob.warning
